messages:
Maria D: Quick heads-up — the migration guide for v1->v2 (examples/migration.md) has two issues: a parameter rename and an embeddings endpoint still pointing at v1.
Kevin L: Which file/PR?
Maria D: It's referenced in https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1745, example block around line ~82.
Ashley R: Oof, that's the copy we surface in onboarding. Can you paste the failing snippet?
Maria D: Sure:
```
# v1 example
client.generate(model_name=\"redwood-alpha\", prompt=\"Hi\")
```
This will raise in v2 where the param is `model` not `model_name`.
Vikram S: Also the embedding example still calls `/v1/embeddings` and uses `model_name`. Both need updating to `/v2/embeddings` and `model`.
Kevin L: I'll open a fix PR to update examples + add a snippet-runner test. Assigning @Ashley R for docs review. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1750
docs-bot: snippet-lint detected 2 examples referencing deprecated param 'model_name' (rule: docs/snippet-compat).
Ashley R: I'll review today. Let's also add a short migration note: "model_name -> model" and show a tiny compatibility shim for SDK users who can't update immediately.
Maria D: Proposed shim wording:
```
# compatibility shim (temporary)
def generate(client, **kwargs):
    if 'model_name' in kwargs and 'model' not in kwargs:
        kwargs['model'] = kwargs.pop('model_name')
    return client.generate(**kwargs)
```
We should discourage long-term use but this helps customers migrate.
Vikram S: Note from runtime: we'll accept `model_name` for ~30 days with a warning header, then return 4xx. Call that out in deprecation notice.
Kevin L: Assigning reviewers: @Ashley R, @Vikram S. ETA: EOD.
deploy-bot: deploy-preview for PR 1750 is available: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood/1750
Ashley R: LGTM modulo one wording nit about "compat shim" -> "compat shim (temporary)". Will merge after CI passes. :thumbsup:
Maria D: Thanks — can someone confirm we have a CI job exercising code snippets? otherwise they rot again.
Kevin L: Added `snippet-runner` job to PR 1750; it runs Python and TS samples against a mocked endpoint.
Ashley R: Merged PR 1750. Closing this thread. :party_parrot:
